answer: Each agent burns a fixed bond to mint one vote, so identity has a flat price and scale buys no discount. A linkability audit is the lantern: if two votes trace back to one device, every bond that attacker posted is slashed together. The river of locked capital is the same marble for each node, so N Sybil votes require N full bonds up front and risk all of them on a single flagged signature. Honest agents lose nothing, while the attacker pays linearly and can forfeit the whole pool, making a fake majority far dearer than an honest one.
